title: Admin Runchain: Lightweight executor for runbooks-as-tasks with contextual retry policies
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a small-footprint executor ("Runchain") that lets ops runbooks be expressed and executed as composable, idempotent tasks. The executor focuses on three goals: 1) make runbooks addressable as discrete tasks with typed inputs/outputs; 2) provide contextual retry and backoff policies driven by recent telemetry (SLO state, rate limits, partial success signals); 3) emit structured provenance and cost/latency telemetry for Console integration. This differs from larger orchestration projects by intentionally targeting quick operator flows and repairlets used by oncall and first-line support rather than long-running data pipelines.
acceptance_criteria: Runchain can receive a JSON task manifest and execute the sequence with retries and at-least-once guardrails
Tasks declare a idempotency key and runtime enforces dedupe for 24h across replicas
Executor publishes per-task tracing with start/end, retries, error-class and token-cost estimates to the ops telemetry pipeline
Can attach a small SLO-check hook that pauses or aborts a runchain step when latency or error budget is breached
Provide a developer shim and example runbook: user-reset-and-telemetry-collection runbook with safe-fallbacks
